title: DigitalGens: a client-side web server for genotyping assay design
description: DigitalGens (https://digitalgens.org/) is a free web server for nucleic-acid assay design. It designs genotyping assays (KASP and allele-specific PCR, TaqMan, minor-groove-binder, molecular-beacon and universal probes, castPCR with blocker oligonucleotides, SNaPshot single-base extension, MLPA and digitalMLPA half-probes, STR/SSR fragment-analysis panels, toehold-exchange probes, paired knock-in and empty-site assays, and loxP/FRT/rox recombinase-site assays) together with PCR and multiplex panels, LAMP, CRISPR guides and diagnostics, gene assembly, in silico PCR and sequence analysis. All computation runs in client-side JavaScript; a pasted or uploaded sequence never leaves the browser, and no account is required.
